component.name: Hermes Iroh
component.summary: Desktop client for the Hermes Agent Iroh-channel plugin

description.p: Hermes Iroh App is a desktop client for the Hermes Agent Iroh-channel plugin. It connects to a Hermes Agent over Iroh, streams assistant responses with Markdown and code rendering, and keeps a durable per-session history.
Response metadata such as model, token usage, context usage, and estimated cost is persisted with completed messages and shown in the composer status.
